children: The Polish finance ministry estimates that at the end of August, the financing of 2026 gross borrowing needs of the state budget stood at around 75%, Deputy Finance Minister Jurand Drop said on Monday in a comment on debt supply for September.
"We estimate that the balance of funds in budget accounts at the end of August will exceed PLN 180 billion ($48.23 billion)," he said in an emailed comment.
